definitions.explanation: A person who analyzes information, data, or situations as a profession or by disposition. Used for financial analysts, political analysts, and also in psychology for psychoanalysts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{分析家|ぶんせきか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: To hear the views of a political analyst.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{分析家|ぶんせきか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: She is known as a sharp analyst.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}{分析家|ぶんせきか}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{景気回復|けいきかいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予測|よそく}している→予測する：19654_yosokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Market analysts are predicting an economic recovery next year.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ (analysis) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (expert/professional suffix).

TYPES:
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{分析家|ぶんせきか}: political analyst
- {市場|しじょう}{分析家|ぶんせきか}: market analyst
- ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧{分析家|ぶんせきか}: psychoanalyst
- ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{分析家|ぶんせきか}: military analyst

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アナリスト: analyst (English loanword, common in business/finance)
- ⟦{評論家|ひょうろんか}→評論家：16405_hyouronka⟧: critic, commentator (more focused on opinions than data)
- ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: researcher (broader, academic focus)

The suffix ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ implies expertise or professional dedication. It appears in many occupation words: ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ (author), ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧ (painter), ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (expert).
